messages:
Renee K: Quick flag 1: OrionEdge integration is blocked during SI delivery. Customer OS policy forbids external pulls and requires OEM-signed images + SBOM provenance for marketplace. Opening SI-5032 to track.

Tom V: Can we do an airgap bundle for them? What's the exact blocker?

Renee K: They require cosign signatures and vendor attestation for both the container and the HSM kernel driver. Also firewall rules block outbound to our control plane IPs.

Asha (SI): Two parallel tracks: 1) produce an images.tar.gz + CycloneDX SBOM + cosign signatures for their registry import; 2) coordinate with EdgeVendor for a signed driver build that matches their pinned kernel. I'll own coordination and the runbook.

EdgeVendor: We can provide a signed driver module and an attestation PDF but need the image digest and build environment details to produce provenance. Send over the digest and CI tag.

Product-Marketing: Heads-up 1: we have a co-announcement scheduled. Hold marketing until SI-5032 is green; please confirm timeline ASAP.

Tom V: I'll assemble the airgap artifact and include checksums + verification commands: `ctr -n k8s.io images import images.tar.gz` and `cosign verify --key vendor.pub <image>`

Asha (SI): Added action items in SI-5032: Tom to build airgap bundle by EOD, EdgeVendor to provide signed driver and attestation within 48h, Renee to pause announcement and update partners. If we can't complete within 72h we'll default apps to hosted routing and notify the customer.

Renee K: Scheduling an architecture call for 03/25 09:00 PT with Orion infra + EdgeVendor + SI. I'll post notes to SI-5032 afterwards.

Product-Marketing: Thanks. Please tag comms channel after the call so we can update the press schedule.
